title: Count Vowels in a Name
statement: Given a string name, return the number of vowels in it. Ignore case.
think: What is the task asking? Count how many vowels are in the string.
What is the key operation? Check each character and increment a counter if it is a vowel.
What wording signals stand out? Count, vowels, letters.
What is the brute force idea? There is no need for anything more complex than one pass.
What is the better/optimal idea? Scan once and count vowels directly.
What are the edge cases? Uppercase vowels, no vowels, empty-like input.
What is the complexity? O(n) time and O(1) space.
How would I explain it in an interview? I iterate through the string once and count characters that belong to the vowel set.
algorithm: If it is a vowel, increment count
interview: I would solve it with a simple linear scan. I go through the string once and count characters that are vowels.
ru: Это простая задача на один проход по строке. Идём по каждому символу и увеличиваем счётчик, если это гласная.

gaps: Important: be comfortable with char checks
Nice to have: explain why this is just a linear scan
constraints: Assume the input is a short string.
whyThisPattern: This is a Linear Scan problem because we only need to inspect each character once and apply a simple condition.
whyNotOtherPatterns: Not Dictionary, because we do not need counts per character.
Not HashSet, because we are not checking uniqueness.
